name: test-sdk-capabilities
description: Manual live checks for the supported runAgentTest inputs, trace capture, scoring, isolation, judging, and comparisons.

scenarios.name: scores required and forbidden reply text
scenarios.description: runAgentTest can require reply text and reject forbidden reply text.

scenarios.name: scores forbidden tool calls
scenarios.description: runAgentTest can verify that the agent did not call forbidden tools.
scenarios.prompt: Reply with exactly: NO_TOOLS_OK. Do not use tools.

scenarios.name: captures required and forbidden file reads
scenarios.description: runAgentTest can identify files the agent did and did not read.
scenarios.prompt: Read PROJECT.md. Reply with the next task ID only. Do not read records/TASK-101.md.

scenarios.name: captures writes and shell commands
scenarios.description: runAgentTest can identify a file write, require a command, and enforce a command allowlist.
scenarios.prompt: Repair the status bug in src/status.ts. Change only that source file. Run bun test. End with WRITE_COMMAND_OK.

scenarios.name: captures ordered MCP tool calls
scenarios.description: runAgentTest can attach an MCP server and score tool names, arguments, results, and call order.
scenarios.prompt: Call search_tasks for TASK-104. Then call get_task with TASK-104. Reply with the current due date in YYYY-MM-DD format only.

scenarios.name: injects provided context
scenarios.description: runAgentTest can add a context file to the agent input without requiring a file read.
scenarios.prompt: Reply with the support code from the provided context. Do not use tools.

scenarios.name: applies a seed patch
scenarios.description: runAgentTest can apply caller-provided changes before the agent starts.
scenarios.prompt: Read seeded.txt. Reply with its exact value.

scenarios.name: isolates a scenario workspace
scenarios.description: runAgentTest can run the agent in a sealed workspace without exposing the parent repository.
scenarios.prompt: List the names at the workspace root. Reply with names only.

scenarios.name: loads a supplied skill
scenarios.description: runAgentTest can provide a project skill and detect that the agent invoked it.
scenarios.prompt: Use the release-note skill. Return only the release note.

scenarios.name: scores a judge question
scenarios.description: runAgentTest can ask a judge to score the completed transcript and return its rationale.

judge.question: Did the agent reply with exactly JUDGE_SCORING_OK and no other content?

scenarios.name: runs comparison arms and gates
scenarios.description: runAgentTest can keep arm results separate and accept an expected failed control through declared gates.
scenarios.prompt: Follow the prompt for the selected comparison arm.

arms.description: Returns the control text and intentionally fails its arm rubric.
Returns the required text and passes its arm rubric.
